description.en: The ID of the region where the Service Mesh instance is located.
A list of mesh instance IDs.
A required parameter. Set the value to `servicemesh`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type servicemesh --resource-id c418807cb4e5840eab018da7d8f5d0000 --tag Value=yahaha Key=test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 c418807cb4e5840eab018da7d8f5d0000 --Tag.1.Key test --Tag.1.Value yahaha --ResourceType servicemesh --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --method POST --force
